messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — Fjord Finance POC kickoff scheduled for tomorrow morning. High-level asks from them: streaming SDK demo, function/tool calling example, structured JSON outputs, SSO + KMS integration details, and a quick pricing ballpark for a 6-week pilot. Security questionnaire is inbound from their infosec.
Priya Patel: I can own the SDK walkthrough. Which language does the customer prefer? Python + JS covers most demos.
Samir Gupta: They asked for low-latency streaming + tool calls. Python and Node SDKs support streaming + tool-calls today. For structured output we recommend the JSON schema validation flag. Quick Python snippet to show streaming + tool-calls:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
with client.streaming_chat(model="rw-medium", tool_calls=True) as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.delta)
```
Jordan (SE): For tool calling the handshake pattern we use short-lived webhook tokens and an HMAC header. Example curl for the webhook handshake:
```bash
curl -X POST https://customer-hook.example.com/handshake -H 'X-Redwood-Sig: sha256=...' -d '{"session_id":"abc123"}'
```
Jordan (SE): Also callout — the SDK will send a `tool_invocation` event before delivering args; pretty small change to adapter.
Alex Chen: Good. On SSO/KMS: Fjord requires SAML SSO for console access and customer-managed KMS for any key material. Do we have a short doc to share?
Priya Patel: We have a one-pager for SAML + KMS for Private deployments. I'll attach after this thread. For Hosted POC we can offer envelope encryption with customer-managed keys via our KMS integration (showing key policy and rotation notes).
Samir Gupta: Note: streaming with KV cache + batching changes token cost. If they want strict token predictability for billing, suggest Dedicated reserved nodes — otherwise usage spikes can vary costs.
Alex Chen: Pricing ask: they want an estimated cost for 100k tokens/day (mixed chat + tool calls) during the POC. Any quick number?
Jordan (SE): Ballpark for Hosted: around $2k–3.5k/mo depending on model family and streaming overhead. Dedicated reserved baseline is higher up-front but predictable — suggest we offer a POC credit and a 6-week discounted reserved trial.
Priya Patel: I'll prepare a short pricing slide: 1) POC hosted (usage, estimate), 2) POC reserved (trial commit), 3) migration checklist.
Alex Chen: Security questionnaire — Fjord's infosec routed a 3rd-party security survey. Nina, can sec team own responses?
Nina (sec-bot): I've flagged this to security@redwood. We need the SOC2 report, vuln-scan cadence, dataflow diagram, and KMS integration docs. ETA: 48 hours for initial bundle.
Samir Gupta: One blocker we've seen in similar POCs: customer wants tool-call responses signed with their key. We can support signing in the webhook adapter — requires HMAC secret exchange during handshake.
Priya Patel: OK — I'll note that in the runbook. Any infra limits we should warn them about?
Jordan (SE): Max concurrent streaming sessions per hosted tenant is configurable, but default is 200. For low-latency SLOs we might need burst capacity on Dedicated.
Alex Chen: Action items: Priya — prepare SDK demo for Python + Node and pricing slide (ETA EOD). Samir — short code sample for signed webhook responses (share snippet). Nina/Sec — security pack in 48h. Jordan — confirm concurrency/latency guidance and recommended Dedicated config.
Priya Patel: Got it. I'll post the demo repo link once ready. :thumbsup:
Samir Gupta: Posting signing snippet in 10.
Nina (sec-bot): Security pack queued. Will follow up if they request additional attestation.
Jordan (SE): I'll ping infra for latency digests and share recommended GPU type for the pilot.
Alex Chen: Thanks team — I’ll update Fjord with these timelines in the kickoff call. :eyes:
